summary: Frobisher is known only from tower listings; a towermen list records Bobby Montgrand there 1996-2002, and no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The tower is named only in the websiteservice listing (coordinates, with no height, year or notes), the Canada Lookouts Saskatchewan index (a bare name in a list), and one towermen entry (Bobby Montgrand, 1996-2002, then aerial detection). No build year, height, design, status or access is recorded because no source read gives one. The name matches the village of Frobisher in southeastern Saskatchewan (a search snippet only). The coordinates here are near 56.5 N, and no source read links the two, so the story does not. Staffing as_of 2002 is the end year of the one entry. The 'all towers condemned' line does not name Frobisher and is used only as a caveat. Searches used: 2. Firelookout.ca pages returned no record data (the index loads by script). A second pass could look for a Frobisher-specific source such as an annual report or a Saskatchewan archive photo record.
